result:
Round 126 is a **PASS**. The Design & UX review is now complete (D3, D4 and D5 written, nothing spilled), and every browser check that can run here was run at 1280×720 and 1440×900. No app source changed: HEAD is still `608187f`, git status is empty and the frozen file-hash list checks OK at the start and the end. A's no-op report matches what I found.

**The main question (D3-A): the SFX lane hidden under the detail panel at 1280×720.** It is friction, not a bug.
- **What happens:** with the round-125 S1 setup, the detail panel sits at 120 px. That is the documented fallback (decision D-29b) when no larger panel height lets all lanes fit. The SFX lane then shows only 5 of its 61 px with the group, or 33 px without it.
- **How you get it back:** one mouse-wheel scroll or one scrollbar drag shows the clip, and collapsing the panel shows every lane.
- **What does not help:** dragging the panel divider down, because 120 px is already the minimum.
- **Why it feels bad:** you select the SFX clip, open the panel to see its details, and the panel hides that same clip.

**New bugs, all Low** (they go to `deferred_low_polish`, so there are no fix-ups before V-0):

| ID | What fails |
|---|---|
| DUX-B-2 | The resize dividers are only 4–6 px and the library folder arrows 16 px wide, with no larger click area (WCAG 2.5.8). Arrow keys still work. |
| DUX-B-3 | Text-field borders are 1.51:1 against the background (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1). |
| DUX-B-4 | The type and duration text on the selected library row is 4.38:1 (needs 4.5:1). |

VISUAL-A's planned darker `outline` colour (#24211E) would make DUX-B-3 worse, so V-1 has to keep field borders at 3:1 or more.

**Other results:**
- **Focus rings:** visible on every Tab stop (67 in S0, 82 in S1, both viewports), at 9.48:1 or better. So the possible Medium did not happen.
- **Feedback speed:** add, move, trim, Undo, mute and export start all show a visible change within 100 ms.
- **First visit:** hearing a sound takes 1 click, putting a clip on a lane 1 click, and starting an export 2 clicks. The exported WAV checked out: 101.352 s, 48 kHz / 24-bit / stereo, exact frame count, no invalid samples.
- **Lane clips cannot be reached with Tab** (0 of 82 stops). No project contract or adopted rule requires it, so I recorded it as idea DUX-R-6 rather than a bug.
- **Part-1 "6 px dead zone" on the Volume fader was my own test error.** That press landed exactly on the slider's right border. A drag that starts anywhere inside the slider changes the value from the first pixel. It can be closed.
- **AltGr:** an AltGr key that types a character (€, @) while the timeline has focus still splits or pastes. Nothing happens while typing in a field, and Undo fixes it in one step, so it is an info note for B, not a bug.
- **Auth guard (G126-3):** a fresh session without credentials still gets "Sign in required" on `/studio/middle-east` at both viewports, and `/api/studio-token` answers 401.

**Recommendations for Saba (DUX-R-3 to 9, all waiting for his answers):**
1. DUX-R-5: keep waveforms in a neutral colour and use the brand colour only for selection, playhead, the main button and focus. This is colour only, so it can go into VISUAL-A V-1.
2. DUX-R-3: keep the selected clip's lane visible automatically.
3. DUX-R-1, extended: make Volume typeable for lanes, Master and now groups, which today show their dB nowhere on screen.
4. DUX-R-4: add a hint in empty audio lanes and say why disabled buttons are disabled.
5. DUX-R-6: let the keyboard select individual clips.

The questions for Saba and the bug/idea index are at the end of the review.

**Limits:**
- There is no Ableton Live on the runner. Live comparisons are confirmed only where I quote the manual (§42.2, 42.5, 42.6, 42.9, 42.16, 42.19); the rest are marked "Live ?".
- Blocked here: the fake-Bearer 403 check (no backend in the cloud), and whether AltGr types its character into a field (the browser automation could not test that).
- No subagent tool was available, so I read the six role files as checklists, one line each in review §8.
- The first page load of the job hit a hydration error. Per the ENV-FIRST-LOAD rule I discarded it once and logged it under `invalidRuns`.

Per the task's outcome table, round 127 should be VISUAL-A V-0 stage 1; the next regression round is due on or after 2026-10-27.
